title: Origin reached a code-hosting development milestone
summary: On 2026-08-19, Cursor’s dated changelog link identified a development item concerning code hosting for Origin. This is material to Origin’s history because it marks a named development direction, but the supplied link alone does not establish its capabilities, availability, or migration implications.
